description: FAST PATH step 2/2: after PUTting the file to the signed URL from `get_upload_url`, call this to publish. NEW name → new doc + share link. Name matching an EXISTING HTML doc → updated in place, same share link. Verifies the uploaded object exists before publishing.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

name.description: Doc name — same rules as host_html_content (existing name = in-place update).

slug.description: Optional. The link ending the person approved through suggest_link. Same rules as host_html_content.

upload_path.description: The upload_path value returned by get_upload_url.

name: finalize_upload
title: Publish an uploaded doc
